description: EAGLEGATE telemetry firewall. Rules are checked top to bottom; the first rule that fires decides. Check rules (authenticity, sequence, rate, range) go above the ALLOW rules they protect. Bump 'version' on every change.

rules.description: Command-type packets never belong on the telemetry downlink

EXAMPLE (disabled): housekeeping must carry a valid MAC; needs the EAGLEGATE_AUTH_KEY secret. The MAC adds mac_bytes to every packet, so raise the sizes in the allow-hk-status / allow-status-3 rules to match before enabling
EXAMPLE (disabled): deny replayed or out-of-order housekeeping packets
EXAMPLE (disabled): housekeeping beacons once per second; deny anything faster
EXAMPLE (disabled): HK_STATUS VALUE (FLOAT32 at byte 6 in cmd_tlm/tlm.txt) must be within its documented limits; replace -100..100 with the real ones
HK_STATUS (APID 2): exactly 11 bytes, the size defined in cmd_tlm/tlm.txt
STATUS_3 (APID 3): exactly 10 bytes, the size defined in cmd_tlm/tlm.txt
EXAMPLE (disabled): allow science APIDs only up to 512 bytes
EXAMPLE (disabled): deny APID 5 when the top bit of byte 6 is set
